chunks: And from him (Al-Shaykh) from Ibn Abi Umayr from Mansur ibn Hazim who said:

I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'The Mutamatti' (one performing Hajj al-Tamattu') must not spend the night in Mina on the Day of Sacrifice (Yawm al-Nahr) until he has visited the House (al-Bayt).'

key_terms.الْمُتَمَتِّعُ: The pilgrim performing Hajj al-Tamattu' (combining Umrah and Hajj).
key_terms.بِمِنًى: In Mina (the tent city near Mecca).
key_terms.يَزُورَ الْبَيْتَ: To visit the House (perform Tawaf around the Kaaba).
key_terms.يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ: The Day of Sacrifice (10th of Dhu al-Hijjah).

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for a Mutamatti' pilgrim regarding Tawaf and spending the night in Mina on the Day of Sacrifice?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* underscores the priority of completing the Tawaf al-Ifadah (Visit of the House) on the 10th of Dhu al-Hijjah before the pilgrim settles in Mina for the days of Tashriq. In Shia jurisprudence, this ruling highlights the spiritual significance of hastening to the Kaaba to fulfill the core pillar of Hajj al-Tamattu' before engaging in the subsequent rituals of stoning the Jamarat and sacrificing the animal, ensuring the pilgrim's state of Ihram is properly concluded through this visit.
